$comment: Canon register for scripts/canon-check.mjs. Every entry excuses exactly one line and
must carry a reason. An entry that stops matching is a stale entry and fails the gate
(exit 2), so this file cannot rot into a blanket permission.
status: "allowed"  — canon-legal: the archival concept (D-04b), a key or identifier, a
history/retired row, a rule declaration, or audit evidence.
status: "baseline" — a known canon defect in a file ticket #5 may not edit. Baseline
entries must name their issue and are capped by maxBaseline.
New live copy goes in src/ and design/copy/copy-deck.md with the canon name. Do not add
entries for new text; rewrite it.
